description: The Creative Writing Minor is open to all students at UCLA. description: The Public Health minor is designed to provide students with a broad conceptual understanding of public health. description: The Social Data Science minor provides students with a solid foundation in the principles and practices of social data science. description: The Minor in Social Thought is an interdisciplinary program for students who wish to study social and political theory and the history of social thought. description: The Society and Genetics minor is designed for students who wish to augment their major program of study with an investigation of the historical, ethical, legal, and social implications of contemporary biological and genetic research. description: The Sociology minor is designed for students who wish to augment their major program of study with a sociological perspective.
